title: Keys: 1-9 follow the sidebar with numbers shown, 0 selects Needs you, first/last, page and group jumps

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
UI review pass on 2026-10-22 (rule u10), from an owner screenshot of the Overview. The owner asked for better key options, more natural control and usability. adj 149 (ui.overview-layout) holds the key choices for decision. It proposes revising record 82 (ui.project-nav: 1-9 in registry order) and adding keys beside record 112 (ui.row-keys). Keys are *proposed* until 149 is decided.

Found:
- 1-9 jump in registry order (internal/tui/model.go:421-424), but the sidebar is sorted needs-first, then running (navigation, model.go:548). The numbers do not match what the owner sees.
- enter on a decision or held row only selects its project (model.go:411-420). The decision's options and recommendation are already in the snapshot (internal/adjcli/adjcli.go:49-50) but cannot be read in the TUI.
- Rows have no first, last or page keys. pgup and pgdown only scroll an open pane (internal/tui/pane.go:56-60).
- The only key hint on screen is "?help" in the sidebar header (internal/tui/view.go:119). The keys valid on the cursor row are not shown.

Depends on S84 (groups for the group-jump keys).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/keys.go`: new bindings (First, Last, PageDown, PageUp, NextGroup, PrevGroup; Jump takes 0).
- `internal/tui/model.go`: the key switch; Jump (around :661) uses the sidebar navigation order instead of the registry index.
- `internal/tui/launch.go`: its Jump case (around :159) follows the same order.
- `internal/tui/view.go`: the sidebar numbers the first nine project rows, dimmed.
- `internal/tui/pane.go`: pgup and pgdown still go to an open pane first.
- Tests: `internal/tui/tui_test.go`, `internal/tui/sidebar_test.go`.
- `testdata/golden/`: sidebar goldens gain the numbers. Regenerate with go test ./internal/tui -update and review the diff.
- `docs/dashboard.md`: the key paragraphs.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestNumberKeysFollowTheSidebar: 1-9 select the first nine projects in the sidebar drawn order, the sidebar shows those numbers dimmed, and 0 selects Needs you.
- TestFirstAndLastRowKeys: g and home go to the first row, G and end to the last.
- TestPageKeysMoveRowsWithoutAPane: with no pane open, pgdown and pgup move the cursor by the body height; with a pane open they still scroll the pane.
- TestGroupJumpKeys: } moves to the first row of the next group, { to the first row of the current or previous group.
- Typing keys stay with the field: g, G, 0, { and } typed into an answer or filter go into the text; digits keep picking options in an owner question (S111) and marking checks on the card (S118).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Owner decisions 2026-10-26 (session a2bf7e0e): S85 is split. This slice keeps the navigation keys. The context hint bar, ctrl+d/u pane scroll and the Questions tab count moved to the hint bar slice. 0 selects Needs you; the Running entry (S110) has no number. Already done by later slices, so not in scope: enter opens a decision (help: "open run, question, item or decision") and the [ and ] project keys (S105).
1. Re-anchor: S105, S110, S111, S118, S119 and S121 changed keys.go and model.go since this spec was written.
2. Tests first; watch each fail for its stated reason.
3. keys.go: add the bindings; Jump takes 0-9.
4. model.go and launch.go Jump: map n to the sidebar navigation order, not m.projects[n]. view.go: prefix the first nine project rows with their number, dimmed.
5. Row movement: First, Last, PageDown and PageUp move the cursor (and the Roadmap cursor on the Roadmap); NextGroup and PrevGroup use the Needs you groups (S84). pgup and pgdown go to the pane first when one is open.
6. Help overlay and docs/dashboard.md key paragraphs.
7. Mutation check: map Jump back to the registry index and confirm TestNumberKeysFollowTheSidebar fails; restore it.
8. go test ./internal/tui -update and review every golden diff. UI slice: UI pass per rule u10 (size M: separate row r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review every changed file in testdata/golden/ by eye.
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .   (expect no output)
- slicer check
- adj lint
- UI pass (rule u10): run the TUI at 80x24 and 120x40, colour and NO_COLOR, and compare with the goldens.
